verdict.rationale: Automating filings and searches is a fair question for a government business-filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive web portal workflows plus mail and in-person submission, with no documented API, CLI, or headless mode. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and a bot-management shell on the bizfile portal, and passing mentions of bulk data files and notary list downloads are adjacent data access, not headless or CI operation of the product.
